triage_summary.root_cause: Todo.from_dict() at src/flywheel/todo.py:70 converts 'id' to int without validating it's positive. Storage.next_id() always returns >=1, but from_dict bypasses this guarantee when loading external JSON.
risk_points: Line 70: todo_id = int(data['id']) accepts any integer including negatives/zeros
from_dict is called by TodoStorage.load() when reading external JSON files
Negative/zero IDs could break assumptions in other code expecting positive IDs
verification_targets: Todo.from_dict({'id': 0, 'text': 'x'}) should raise ValueError with 'positive' in message
Todo.from_dict({'id': -1, 'text': 'x'}) should raise ValueError with 'positive' in message
triage_summary.proposed_fix_location: src/flywheel/todo.py:70-74 - add validation after int conversion
triage_summary.test_location: tests/test_issue_2000_json_validation.py - add tests for negative/zero id
